# `hub.authority_generation`

Private authority generation. Triggers on users, organizations, companies, memberships, agent_principals, agent_authority, role_capabilities and permission_state advance it in the writing transaction.

Database: `hub`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | INTEGER | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Singleton key, always 1. |
| `generation` | INTEGER | no | — | — | — | — | Count of writes to the permission input tables; database triggers advance it. |
| `token` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | Random value redrawn by the same triggers on every such write; a permission read may reuse earlier facts only while it is unchanged. |
